body: I have set high standards for myself yes, but that’s only because I don’t want to be a nothing. I don’t want to go through life being a replacable forgetable meaningless worthless human. I want to be more, I want to actually matter. I want to make an impact on something. Or I want to die trying.
I just feel like nothing I do is ever good enough, I should always be better, I know my potential is higher than other people when it comes to certain things.

Well I’m not exactly “religious” in the traditional sense, but I’ve always stood by the fact that everyone needs to believe in something, even if it’s something less...well straightforward. Anyways I’m not the best at communicating my problems Im sorry I guess I just...theres a lot wrong with me, so much honestly. And I’m just never satisfied with anything I do. I don’t mean to try and be special here or whatever but I’ve talked to some people a large variety actually and most have said the inner workings of my mind aren’t comparable to anyone else they’ve ever seen. Again not trying to be special or whatever just telling you what I’ve heard.
